definition: white crystals you add to food for flavour
description: In a stone kitchen by the sea, a hand pinches coarse white salt from a small wooden pot and sprinkles it over a board of ripe tomato slices while a seagull watches through the open window; a couple licks salt from their fingers and bites into the salted tomatoes with bread, delighted at the taste.

de.answer: Sie gibt Salz auf die Tomaten.
